falsifier: Point `gdlmem.py brief <tu>`'s webfrank_pins block, or any shipped tool, at one of the 48 flagged pins and show that its unreachability claim is ALREADY screenable -- that some existing field or command answers 'does this still hold today?' without re-deriving the cap. That would make the convention redundant and this law wrong. Measured today it is not, and the check is a grep any lane can run from the repo root: `Select-String -Path config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json -Pattern '"(falsifier|expiry_check|provenance)"\s*:'` returns NO MATCHES over all 154 entries, while the same file's `"mechanism"` key returns 113 -- the only rule fields in use are function, before_sha256, after_sha256, audit, mechanism and the per-stage flags. The law also dies if the fn_800DA60C precedent is single: exhibit the 48 flagged pins re-probed at a new alignment with none reopening, and the class is a paper risk rather than a live one -- note that would REFUTE the priority, not the schema gap.
subject: tool:webfrank
value: A WEBFRANK PIN'S `mechanism` PROSE THAT ASSERTS SOURCE-UNREACHABILITY IS A DENIAL OF FUTURE MATCHING WORK, AND THE PIN SCHEMA IS THE ONE PLACE IN THIS PROJECT WHERE A DENIAL NEED NOT SAY HOW TO CLEAR IT. Measured at 7fe2f4a9f over config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json: 154 rule entries over 152 distinct (unit, function) pairs (game/ui/message::msgDraw and game/world/btricol::LineLineDist carry two entries each, which reconciles the file against progress's 'EQUIVALENT 11.25% (152 fns)'); 113 entries carry `mechanism` prose and 41 carry none; and ZERO carry a `falsifier`, `expiry_check` or `provenance` key, because the schema has nowhere to put one. 48 of the 152 functions assert source-unreachability or axis-exhaustion in that prose. The corpus already refuses this shape twice elsewhere and permits it here: an attempt record denying future work in prose is quarantined by `context` with the UNGATED-PROSE-DENIAL banner ('it states no scope, no premise measurement, no expiry_check command, and no falsifier ... treat it as a WEAK veto'), and AGENTS.md's run-49 rule says a HEADER COMMENT that would stop someone is a hint until it carries a date and a falsification command. A pin is strictly stronger than either: it is shipped configuration that also freezes the function's source by hash. THE COST IS MEASURED, NOT HYPOTHETICAL. game/movie/movieplayer::fn_800DA60C's pin recorded its residual as NOT source-reachable and was wrong for three days: attempt.MP_fn800da60c-source-exact-via-a-real-virtual-call-rule-deleted.20260903.v1 closed it at source and DELETED the rule, as did attempt.MP_fn800d967c-source-exact-via-a-real-virtual-call-rule-deleted.20260903.v1 on its sibling, and neither function appears in webfrank.json today. What made the claim stale was not new evidence about fn_800DA60C but a NEW LAW in its residual's family landing on a neighbour (claim.law.MP_the-mwcc-virtual-call-loads-the-vtable-into-r12-and-the-vptr-sits-after-the-class-data.20260903.v1) -- which is why the expiry check that generalises is a family query, not a re-probe: `gdlmem.py laws --residual "<the pin's own signature>"`, where any law newer than the pin reopens it. THE PROVENANCE IS NOT THE GAP. A strict record-id regex initially scored 2 of the 48 as citing nothing (atree::fn_80011BBC, critter::CritterDoTexmodNode); both cite a real record without its version suffix, and all 48 cite at least one resolvable record. Several mechanisms are exemplary prose -- sfx::StartThrowMagicFX names six spent axes verbatim ('the 2026-08-29 cap measured statement placement x4, cast-transit, assignment-in-index, the size-parameter copy, the e/ep association chains and a multi-definition compound-mask ... all byte-identical to baseline') -- and that is exactly the point: the best-provenanced denial in the file is still unscreenable, because provenance says what WAS measured and a falsifier says what would make it stop being true. THE CONVENTION IS A CODIFICATION, NOT AN INVENTION, AND THE MEASUREMENT SAYS SO: of the 48 flagged pins, TWELVE already cite a record whose typed `denial` carries BOTH an expiry_check and a falsifier (critter::CritterGetTargetPlayers, enemy::do_enemies, player::PlayerProcessPowerups, mb_camera::MBCameraUpdate, pb_texture::fn_800C72DC, memcard::init_all_dir_info, sysservice::sysResetService, attract::scroll_credits, screensaver::print_n_of_m, items::PlaceItem, newcam::fn_8006F16C, tower::towerRecordLevelBeaten) and THIRTY-SIX cite no record that does. So: a rule entry whose mechanism asserts unreachability discharges an `unreachability` obligation shaped like the attempt-record `denial` block the graph already gates -- {scope, premise_measurement, expiry_check, falsifier} -- EITHER inline in the pin OR by citing a record that carries one, and it ships ADVISORY, because a refusal would fire on 48 of 152 live pins and refusing a third of the shipped rule corpus on a schema change is the failure mode the two-sided-calibration rule exists to prevent. THE VOCABULARY IS NARROWER THAN IT READS, so a gate should use the five triggers that fired and not the four that did not: 'not source-reachable' 10, 'exhausted' 29, bare 'unreachable' 10, 'no source form/spelling/shape/expression' 6, 'source-unreachable' 4; 'cannot be expressed', 'no C ... produces', 'spellings failed' and 'all N forms failed' matched zero pins each.
